items.question: Who is Tina Charles?
items.answer: Tina Charles is a retired WNBA center and the league's all-time leading rebounder. The Connecticut Sun drafted her first overall in 2010. She was the unanimous 2010 Rookie of the Year, the 2012 MVP, an eight-time All-Star, and a three-time Olympic gold medalist.

items.question: Did Tina Charles retire?
items.answer: Yes. Tina Charles announced her retirement on May 5, 2026, after 14 WNBA seasons.

items.question: What are Tina Charles's stats?
items.answer: In the 2025 regular season, Tina Charles averaged 16.3 points, 5.8 rebounds, and 1.7 assists in 43 games for the Connecticut Sun.

items.question: Where did Tina Charles play college basketball?
items.answer: Tina Charles played four seasons at UConn and won NCAA championships in 2009 and 2010. She was the 2009 NCAA Tournament Most Outstanding Player and the 2010 AP Player of the Year.

items.question: How tall is Tina Charles?
items.answer: The WNBA lists Tina Charles at 6 feet 4 inches and 192 pounds.

items.question: Which teams did Tina Charles play for?
items.answer: Tina Charles has played for the Connecticut Sun, New York Liberty, Washington Mystics, Phoenix Mercury, Seattle Storm and Atlanta Dream.
